network.operation: Use the Barge guard's Quick-Travel option after Bone Voyage.
network.post_quest_interaction_shape: The current Quick-Travel interaction is the post-quest barge travel mechanism. Jagex's approved quality-of-life change specifies one interaction each way rather than the original three-NPC sequence.

network_behavior.repeat_use: Discovered endpoints can be selected through the Magic Mushtree transport interface for movement around Fossil Island.

repeat_cost.note: The registered sources describe endpoint discovery and network transport without a fare, consumable, rune, or charge cost.

records.name: Digsite pendant Fossil Island destination and repeat-use lifecycle

make_or_use_gates.museum_enchantment_knowledge: An archaeologist teaches the enchantment after the player finds and hands in a clean necklace while cleaning uncleaned finds in the Varrock Museum.
make_or_use_gates.clean_necklace_acquisition: The published chance per uncleaned-find clean is 1/51.
make_or_use_gates.enchant_condition: The registered source specifies either 49 Magic or an Enchant ruby or topaz tablet.

charge_and_destination_behavior.each_teleport: Uses one remaining pendant teleport charge for the selected unlocked destination.
charge_and_destination_behavior.zero_charges: The pendant cannot be recharged and crumbles to dust when its final teleport charge is used.

base_destination.name: Digsite
base_destination.location: North of the Digsite, west of the canal barge.

fossil_island_binding.machine: Southern Strange Machine displaying a book with symbols
fossil_island_binding.machine_location: House on the Hill, north-east of Museum Camp on Fossil Island
fossil_island_binding.binding_input: A Digsite pendant with any positive number of charges
fossil_island_binding.permanent_account_effect: Adds the Fossil Island (House on the Hill) destination to the pendant currently used and to future Digsite pendants.
fossil_island_binding.binding_charge_ledger: The current registered Wiki text states that a pendant of any amount of charges may be used for the binding and that the option applies to future pendants; it does not explicitly state that the binding itself consumes a teleport charge. This record therefore does not infer a charge deduction for the binding interaction.
fossil_island_binding.reversal: Using a pendant on the same machine again can unbind this teleport option.

charge_and_destination_behavior.unlocked_destination_restriction: Attempting to teleport to a destination that has not been unlocked displays a failure message instead of teleporting.

records.confidence: high for published creation, teleport-charge, and destination-unlock mechanics; high that the source does not explicitly specify charge consumption for the binding interaction.
